faqs.a: Our team answers during business hours in the US and Bangladesh offices, Monday to Friday.

faqs.q: How fast will I get a reply?
faqs.a: Most messages get a reply within 2 hours during business hours.

faqs.q: How do I get help setting up a product?
faqs.a: Choose Setup help above and tell us which product and step you're on, or open live chat for a quick answer.

faqs.q: Where do I report a bug?
faqs.a: Write to us with Something else selected, or email support@inkybay.com with a screenshot and your store URL.
